candidates.title: Consistency Wins
candidates.topic: Why Scorpio likes people who follow through on what they say they will do
candidates.angle: Test whether a concrete trust-building behavior outperforms broad “loyalty” language.
candidates.copy: Scorpio is drawn to people whose actions stay consistent after the excitement wears off. This explores why follow-through can feel more attractive than big promises.

candidates.title: Say It Clearly
candidates.topic: Why Scorpio likes people who communicate directly instead of sending mixed signals
candidates.angle: Frame attraction around emotional clarity and the relief of not having to decode mixed signals.
candidates.copy: Scorpio may be intrigued by mystery, but lasting interest grows when someone can say what they mean. The focus is direct communication without games.
candidates.testedVariable: Communication clarity as the attraction trigger

candidates.title: Keep It Private
candidates.topic: Why Scorpio likes people who respect confidentiality and protect the relationship’s private side
candidates.angle: Use privacy and discretion as a relationship-specific form of respect, not as an abstract personality label.
candidates.copy: For Scorpio, trust can deepen when someone protects private conversations and does not turn intimacy into public content. This gives discretion a clear everyday meaning.
candidates.testedVariable: Privacy and discretion versus emotional intensity

candidates.title: Have Your Own Life
candidates.topic: Why Scorpio likes people who are confident, self-directed, and not dependent on constant attention
candidates.angle: Position independence as secure attachment: attraction grows when both people have a full life outside the relationship.
candidates.copy: Scorpio can appreciate someone who is deeply invested without becoming dependent on constant reassurance. This angle explores the pull of confidence, space, and self-direction.
